feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 August 2026 10:13pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 02 August 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds possible for a time.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near Greenland, with low pressure southwest of Ireland, tracking northeast.


##Wind##

East or Northeast 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 overnight, then veering East or Southeast later in the night or at first tomorrow morning, and possibly touching 6 in a few places. Decreasing East or Southeast 3 or 4 later in morning or early afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate overnight, then slight again by tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, becoming more persistent and heavier tomorrow evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or Southeast 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 tomorrow night, veering South on Tuesday morning and afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Rain developing for a time, possibly heavy.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
